metadata.description: Staz's Claude Code skills and agents.

plugins.name: orc
plugins.description: Orchestrator: keep working in your main session, and hand a piece to a cheaper or stronger tier agent only when it actually pays off.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Save notes to, and recall them from, your Obsidian vaults: one vault per job plus a personal one, each with its own house rules.

plugins.name: review-pr
plugins.description: Review someone else's PR with an agent at your side, including code in a language you don't read well: plain-language explanation, independently verified findings, a draft you approve before anything is posted.

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Turn a dense doc, page, issue or topic into a short animated step-through HTML explainer, built only from the source, with honest Confirmed / Likely / Not known chips. Writes one file; never publishes.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: A Yesterday / Today / Blockers standup report from your real GitHub activity. Plain text to read out or paste; never posts.
